title: I made Monkey Do, a 3D roguelite, in two days using Claude Opus 5.5 and three.js
author: DaveFromMarketing_
selftext:
Not a game dev, just someone who's sunk way too many hours into roguelites. So I made one where you play as a capuchin monkey who dual wields guns (and holds 3 more).  
  
In most roguelites, if your build isn't coming together, is you're basically just waiting to die. I wanted a game where good movement can maybe extend your run even when your build is garbage.   
  
You can wall run, wall climb, chain slides into jumps, air roll, and swing through trees.  
  
You can play it here: [https://bigwavedave25.itch.io/monkey-do](https://bigwavedave25.itch.io/monkey-do)
